Messages.Author: Martin Ward
Messages.Body:
I haven't seen anything official on the net, nor any announcement in a
Duelist, but from some of the talk on this newsgroup it seems that there is no
longer a restricted list. True? Is there a banned list? If yes, then all I can
say is that I haven't heard or seen any type of announcement.

Question: Do retainers like Wolf Companion, Zombie, and Murder of Crows do
their damage as part of the vampire's strike damage? In other words, there is
only one strike and one strike resolution? Can this damage be prevented by
just playing one Skin of Steel? If said vampire Blurs, then the retainers
would do more damage or not?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Martin Ward wrote:
>
> I haven't seen anything official on the net, nor any announcement in a
> Duelist, but from some of the talk on this newsgroup it seems that there is no
> longer a restricted list. True? Is there a banned list? If yes, then all I can
> say is that I haven't heard or seen any type of announcement.

Since the latest DCI rules went into effect (Oct. 1996), there has
been no restricted list. The Banned list consistst of (1) All Ante
cards, (2) All Paralyze cards, and (3) the Monocle of Clarity.

This is up on WotC's official web site: www.wizards.com/DCI

> Question: Do retainers like Wolf Companion, Zombie, and Murder of Crows do
> their damage as part of the vampire's strike damage?

No.

> In other words, there is
> only one strike and one strike resolution?

Yes. (Not accounting for any additional strikes).
Damage from retainers is applied during this single strike
resolution, but is not part of the strike.

> Can this damage be prevented by
> just playing one Skin of Steel?

No. Skin of Steel only prevents damage from strikes.

> If said vampire Blurs, then the retainers
> would do more damage or not?

No. Retainers only deal damage during the first strike resolution.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
